items.title: Polyplex Thailand unit to invest Rs 147 cr in new 12,000 MT BOPP/BOPE film line
items.text: Polyplex's subsidiary Polyplex (Thailand) Public Company Limited will invest Rs 147 crore (about $15.2 million), funded from internal accruals, to add 12,000 MT per year of BOPP/BOPE film on a current base of 98,045 MT per year. The package includes a second-hand line bought from Taghleef Industries Inc. for $2.91 million, and machinery is expected to be fully functional by Q4 FY2027-28. The report does not mention capacitor film, so this is packaging-film capacity news only; it is a secondary source and not yet checked against the exchange filing.

sources.title: Polyplex Corporation subsidiary to expand Thailand capacity with INR 147 crore investment

items.title: Jindal Poly AGM: FY26 audit qualified over JPFL Films fire inventory valuation
items.text: At its 52nd AGM on 30 Sep 2026, Jindal Poly Films shareholders adopted the FY2026 accounts. Auditors issued a modified opinion on the consolidated results because damaged inventory at subsidiary JPFL Films could not be fully valued after the fire, as physical verification was still ongoing. Management said the qualification has no material financial impact. JPFL Films is the unit behind the Rs 250 cr capacitor-film doubling plan, so the fire and audit uncertainty remain a governance and execution overhang for that thesis.

sources.title: Jindal Poly Films AGM Highlights: Auditor Qualification Reported; Directors Re-appointed
